category_wise_vacancies: Post Name
Eligibility Criteria
Mechanic-cum-Operator (Drilling)

Candidates must have an ITI Certificate in Mechanic (Earth Moving Machinery), Diesel Mechanic, Motor Mechanic, or Fitter trade , or a Diploma in Mechanical, Automobile, or Drilling Engineering from a recognized institution.
Technician (Survey)
Candidates must have an ITI Certificate in Survey trade or a Diploma in Survey Engineering from a recognized institution.
Accountant
Candidates must be a Graduate and should have passed the Intermediate level of CA/ICWA . Desirable proficiency for the role includes Basic Computer Knowledge and SAP-FICO .
Technician (Sampling)
Candidates must have an B.Sc Degree from a recognized university.
Technician (Laboratory)
Candidates must have a B.Sc. Degree in Chemistry, Physics, or Geology from a recognized institution.
Assistant (Materials)

Candidates must be a Graduate with Mathematics or hold a B.Com. Degree from courses approved by UGC and AICTE, wherever applicable , with the degree recognized by the respective authorities. ODL (Open and Distance Learning) degrees are also permissible . Desirable proficiency for the role includes Basic Computer Knowledge and SAP-MM .
Assistant (Accounts)

Candidates must have a B.Com. Degree from a course approved by UGC and AICTE, wherever applicable , with the degree recognized by the respective authorities. ODL (Open and Distance Learning) degrees are also permissible . Desirable proficiency for the role includes Basic Computer Knowledge and SAP-FICO .
Stenographer (English)

Candidates must have a Graduate Degree in any stream along with a Certificate in Shorthand with a speed of 80 words per minute in English . The degree should be from a course approved by UGC and AICTE, wherever applicable , and recognized by the respective authorities. ODL (Open and Distance Learning) degrees are also permissible . Desirable proficiency for the role includes Basic Computer Knowledge .
Assistant (Hindi)

Candidates must have a Graduate Degree with Hindi and English as subjects , or a Degree in English along with having passed an equivalent examination in Advanced Hindi . The degree should be from a course approved by UGC and AICTE, wherever applicable , and recognized by the respective authorities. ODL (Open and Distance Learning) degrees are also permissible . Desirable proficiency for the role includes Basic Computer Knowledge with Hindi .
Electrician
Candidates must have ITI in Electrical trade or a Diploma in Electrical Engineering , along with a valid Wireman Certificate .
Machinist

Candidates must have an ITI Certificate in Turner, Machinist, Grinder, or Miller trade , or a Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Production Engineering, or Tool & Die Engineering .
Technician (Drilling)

Candidates must have an ITI Certificate in Mechanic (Earth Moving Machinery), Diesel Mechanic, Motor Mechanic, or Fitter trade , or a Diploma in Drilling or Mechanical Engineering . Candidates must also possess a valid HMV (Heavy Motor Vehicle) License .
Mechanic

Candidates must have an ITI Certificate in Diesel Mechanic, Motor Mechanic, or Fitter trade , or a Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Automobile Engineering, Production Engineering, or Manufacturing Engineering . Candidates must also possess a valid HMV (Heavy Motor Vehicle) License .
Junior Driver
Candidates must have passed 10th Class and possess both a valid LMV (Light Motor Vehicle) License and a valid HMV (Heavy Motor Vehicle) License .
Assistant (IT)

Candidates must have a BCA, BCS, BCCA, B.Sc. in Computer Science/IT/Computer Applications, or Bachelor of Information System & Management (BISM) degree from a recognized university. Alternatively, candidates may have Graduation in any stream along with a minimum 01-year Diploma after Graduation or PG Diploma in IT, Computer Science, or Computer Applications from a recognized Board/University.
Assistant (HR)

Candidates must have a BA, B.Com, B.Sc., BBA, BBM, or BSW Degree from a recognized institution. The course should be approved by UGC and AICTE, wherever applicable , and the degree should be recognized by the respective authorities. ODL (Open and Distance Learning) degrees are also permissible . Desirable proficiency for the role includes Basic Computer Knowledge and SAP-HCM .
